result:
Implementation complete. Summary:

Implemented the 6 signer/audit-certificate endpoints under `/api/v1/contracts/{contractId}/...` that this task owns (list, add, update, delete signers; send-for-signature; audit certificate download), reusing the foundation task's existing `signers`/`audit_certificates`/`esignature_settings` tables and models. Added `app/schemas/signer.py`, `app/repositories/signers.py`, `app/services/signers.py`, `app/routers/signers.py`, wired into `app/main.py`, and extended the shared `ContractStatus` Literal additively with `"Sent"`.

- `python -m compileall app` and `pytest -q` pass (247/247, including 34 new tests in `tests/test_signers.py`)
- Verified live via uvicorn: all 5 routes appear in `/openapi.json`; 401/403 confirmed end-to-end
- Key judgement calls documented in `blockers`: the "Approved" vs "Ready For Signature" precondition contradiction, an added `"Pending"` pre-send signer status, deterministic (not random) integrated-provider-failure simulation for AF-005, lazy audit-certificate generation, and the pre-existing no-Postgres sandbox gap

Result written to `.api-gen/outputs/T-CONTRACTS-API.json`.

nohup uvicorn app.main:app --port 5199 > /tmp/uvicorn.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
curl -s -o /tmp/openapi.json -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5199/openapi.json

mkdir -p /tmp/wk && nohup uvicorn app.main:app --port 5199 > uvicorn_signers.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
curl -s -o openapi_signers.json -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5199/openapi.json
pkill -f "uvicorn app.main:app" || true; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5199/health 2>/dev/null || echo "server down"
